title: nmdist_occurrence_block_distances.tsv
description: Row schema for nmdist_occurrence_block_distances.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF, header row required.

replicon_accession.description: NCBI nucleotide accession of the replicon.

bioproject_accession.description: NCBI BioProject accession; the bootstrap cluster.

frozen_group.description: Frozen species group for the distance analyses: A. baumannii, Klebsiella group, P. aeruginosa, or other.

portability_class.description: Frozen five-class portability state: A chromosomal no marker, B chromosomal MGE context, C plasmid no marker, D plasmid mobilizable, E plasmid conjugative.

wrapped_circular.description: 1 if the window wraps the circular origin.

truncated.description: 1 if the window was truncated by a replicon end.

block_n_args.description: Number of ARG occurrences in the block.

weight_block_balanced.description: Block-balanced weight, 1/m for an occurrence in a block of m; weights sum to 21,955.

s2_selected.description: 1 if selected for sensitivity S2 (one genome per BioProject).

dist_any_bp.description: Distance in bp to the nearest MGE marker of any class within the window; blank if censored.

dist_is_bp.description: Distance to the nearest IS/transposase marker.

dist_integrase_bp.description: Distance to the nearest integrase/integron marker.

censored_any.description: 1 if no marker of any class within 10 kb.

censored_is.description: 1 if no IS/transposase marker within 10 kb.

censored_integrase.description: 1 if no integrase marker within 10 kb.

overlap_zero.description: 1 if a marker directly overlaps the determinant.

in_block_feature_beyond_window.description: 1 if the block contains a marker that lies OUTSIDE this occurrence's own window. 111 occurrences; censored, not counted positive.
